name: band-glass
prompt: The background is pure flat black and completely empty for the entire shot. No room, no floor, no horizon, no objects, no text, no logos, no numbers, no people. Only the glowing element described, isolated on black, as if shot in a blacked-out void. Seen through a sheet of dark smoked glass: a faint amber circuit-board pattern of fine etched lines and tiny rectangles, drifting very slowly from left to right, with soft highlights sliding across the glass surface. Barely visible, extremely low contrast, deep shadow, almost entirely black. Continuous and steady for the entire shot. Static camera.
